```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### Simple Dropdown Menu Example

```{r}
library(plotly.core)
library(MASS)

covmat <- matrix(c(0.8, 0.4, 0.3, 0.8), nrow = 2, byrow = T)
df <- mvrnorm(n = 10000, c(0, 0), Sigma = covmat)
df <- as.data.frame(df)

colnames(df) <- c("x", "y")
df |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y,
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scatter_marker(
      opacity = 0.3,
      line = go_scatter_marker_line(color = "black", width = 1)
    )
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Drop down menus - Plot type",
    xaxis = go_xaxis(domain = c(0.1, 1)),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(title = "y"),
    updatemenus = list(
      go_updatemenu(
        y = 0.8,
        buttons = list(
          go_updatemenu_button(
            method = "restyle",
            args = list("type", "scatter"),
            label = "Scatter"
          ),
          go_updatemenu_button(
            method = "restyle",
            args = list("type", "histogram2d"),
            label = "2D Histogram"
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
```

### Add Two Dropdown Menus to Restyle Graph

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

x <- seq(-2 * pi, 2 * pi, length.out = 1000)
df <- data.frame(x, y1 = sin(x), y2 = cos(x))

df |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~x, y = ~y1, mode = "lines", name = "A") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~x, y = ~y2, mode = "lines", name = "B", visible = FALSE) |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Drop down menus - Styling",
    xaxis = go_xaxis(domain = c(0.1, 1)),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(title = "y"),
    updatemenus = list(
      go_updatemenu(
        y = 0.8,
        buttons = list(
          go_updatemenu_button(
            method = "restyle",
            args = list("line.color", "blue"),
            label = "Blue"
          ),
          go_updatemenu_button(
            method = "restyle",
            args = list("line.color", "red"),
            label = "Red"
          )
        )
      ),
      go_updatemenu(
        y = 0.7,
        buttons = list(
          go_updatemenu_button(
            method = "restyle",
            args = list("visible", list(TRUE, FALSE)),
            label = "Sin"
          ),
          go_updatemenu_button(
            method = "restyle",
            args = list("visible", list(FALSE, TRUE)),
            label = "Cos"
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
```
